maturity_model.interpretation: Controls are assigned to a progression stage by this assessment methodology using the practices described by GitHub Well-Architected as the reference. GitHub does not publish this exact control-to-stage mapping for this assessment catalog.
maturity_model.achievement_rule: A stage is achieved only when all controls assigned to that stage and all preceding stages are PASS or N/A. PARTIAL, FAIL and NOT ASSESSED block achievement.
maturity_model.domain_maturity: The domain maturity is the highest achieved stage. If Start is not achieved, the domain is reported as Below Start / Not achieved.
maturity_model.provisional_rule: If evidence coverage is insufficient, the stage is marked provisional and cannot be treated as a definitive maturity conclusion.
